name: ErrorNotice
summary: Displays a public API failure message and an optional reload action.

props.name: error
props.meaning: Mapped through the shared public failure-message boundary.

props.name: operation
props.meaning: Selects the failure wording; failed or lost writes are reported as unknown outcomes. Defaults to read.

props.name: messages
props.meaning: Module-specific wording for its own stable error codes.

props.name: onReload
props.meaning: Optional recovery action when current data can be refreshed.

props.name: reloadLabel
props.meaning: Accessible name of the reload action; defaults to Reload.

accessibility: Uses role=alert so the failure is announced; the optional reload control is a native button.
usage: Pass the original error to preserve stable-code mapping. Offer reload only when the current data can be refreshed, and never imply that an unknown write outcome failed.

examples.label: Unavailable service with reload
examples.description: A synthetic SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE response; no live request is involved.
